summary: Russian forces conducted widespread strikes on Ukrainian energy and port infrastructure, hitting a gas station in Dnipropetrovsk region killing three, guided bombs on Zaporizhzhia wounding 11, and destroying four military cargo vessels in Mykolaiv port and the Black Sea. Ukrainian drones struck Russian territory nightly, with 245 UAVs reportedly destroyed over Crimea, Tula, and Belgorod regions, while a drone crash in Gelendzhik killed at least three civilians. On the ground, Russian troops control Kupyansk city center and are advancing near Konstantinovka and Sumy, where fighting rages 13-15 km from the city outskirts.
key_points: Russian guided bombs struck a gas station in Shyrokivska hromada, Kryvyi Rih district, killing three and causing a fire (Source: @UkraineNow/83146).
Ukrainian drones attacked Crimea, Tula, and Belgorod regions overnight; Russian air defense claimed 245 UAVs destroyed the previous day (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132).
Russian forces destroyed a section of the Cherevkovsky bridge in Slavyansk and struck port infrastructure in Odesa and Mykolaiv regions (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132).
In Belgorod region, a Ukrainian drone strike near a playground killed a 13-year-old girl and injured two other children (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132).
Russian troops control Kupyansk city center and are fighting for the bridge over the Oskol River at Kupyansk-Uzlovoy (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132).
Six Russian FABs bombed the former Frunze Plant in Sumy; fighting is ongoing 13-15 km from Sumy's northern outskirts (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32142).
A drone crashed onto a beach in Gelendzhik, Russia, killing three (per Russian governor) or six (per Ukrainian source) and injuring 13-17 (Source: @UkraineNow/83147, @ukr_leaks_eng/32145).
US and Ukraine are consulting on transferring Patriot production technology, though Congress notes resolution is "very, very difficult" (Source: @tass_agency/388526).

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces intensified strikes on Ukrainian critical infrastructure, including a deadly gas station attack in Dnipropetrovsk region, guided bomb strikes on Zaporizhzhia, and the destruction of four military cargo vessels in Mykolaiv port and the Black Sea. Ukrainian drone campaigns expanded across western Russian regions, with mass overnight attacks repelled in Crimea, Tula, and Belgorod, while a drone crash in Gelendzhik caused civilian casualties. Ground combat continues to favor Russian advances in Kupyansk and the Sumy direction, where fighting approaches within 15 km of the city.

points: Ukrainian air defense repelled massive overnight drone attacks on Crimea, Tula, and Belgorod regions, with Russian sources claiming 245 UAVs destroyed in a single day, indicating sustained long-range strike capacity (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132).

The SBU detained a Ukrainian soldier accused of transmitting coordinates of gas stations in Poltava region to Russian forces, highlighting internal security threats amid infrastructure targeting (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32136).
A methanol leak occurred in Poltava region following an air strike, adding environmental hazard to infrastructure damage (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32126).

Former State Secretary of the MFA Oleksandr Bankov was arrested on suspicion of embezzling international aid at the start of the full-scale invasion, with bail set at 10 million UAH (Source: @UkraineNow/83137).

Eleven individuals, including the former head of a military unit's financial service, were notified of suspicion for fraudulently documenting combat participation to receive monthly bonuses up to 100,000 UAH from August 2023 to October 2024 (Source: @UkraineNow/83138).

President Zelensky appointed Rustem Umerov as Head of the Foreign Intelligence Service and Ihor Klymenko as Secretary of the National Security and Defense Council, signaling leadership reshuffles in security apparatus (Source: @DeepStateUA/23717).

In Poland, three Ukrainian citizens were hospitalized after an attack in a Kozhukhiv hostel reportedly triggered by music from a car; assailants shouted "go back to Ukraine" and police are searching for suspects (Source: @UkraineNow/83126).

Russian MVD officially advised citizens to avoid sharing views in chats, arguing on "provocative topics," meeting strangers, or disclosing personal information, citing recruitment threats but likely reflecting Kremlin anxiety over domestic reaction to refinery strikes, fuel shortages, and mobilization rumors (Source: @UkraineNow/83153).

A drone crashed onto a beach in Gelendzhik (Krasnodar Krai), killing at least three and injuring 13 per Governor Kondratyev, with OSINT videos showing Russian air defense engagement prior to impact; Ukraine has not commented (Source: @UkraineNow/83147).

Ukrainian drone strikes in Belgorod region killed a 13-year-old girl near a playground in Printsevka, injured two other girls, and wounded four in Kazachya Lisitsa from rocket fire; a drone also hit a commercial facility in Koroch injuring two including a child (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132).
Russian fuel supply in Kaluga region stabilized with 93% of gas stations stocked and queues disappearing, per Governor Shapsha, after earlier panic (Source: @tass_agency/388491).
Putin arrived in Krasnoyarsk for a working visit, per TASS correspondent (Source: @tass_agency/388511).

Russian FAS issued a warning to Apple to eliminate discriminatory conditions for Russian search engines and comply with domestic software pre-installation requirements on iOS devices (Source: @tass_agency/388521).
A fire erupted at a Wildberries logistics facility in Vladimir region following an attack, prompting evacuations (Source: @tass_agency/388515).
Russian guided aerial bombs (KABs) struck Donetsk region, per monitoring channel (Source: @kpszsu/71365).
In Zaporizhzhia city, Russian guided aerial bombs damaged high-rise buildings, vehicles, and warehouses, wounding 11 civilians according to OVA (Source: @UkraineNow/83125).

Russian forces destroyed a column of fuel tankers in Zaporizhzhia region, with Ukrainian side disseminating footage that contradicts local governor's earlier claims of road control (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132).
Russian troops struck the Cherevkovsky bridge in Slavyansk (Donetsk region), destroying a section to hinder Ukrainian logistics (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132).

Guided UAVs and high-speed targets were observed over Dnipropetrovsk region heading toward Dnipro from the north and south, with launches of guided aerial bombs reported on the region (Source: @kpszsu/71363, @kpszsu/71381, @eRadarrua/103830).
A gas station in Kryvyi Rih (Dnipropetrovsk region) was destroyed in a Russian attack, the second such strike in the area recently (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32147, @UkraineNow/83146).
Russian UAV operators from the Varyag brigade destroyed a locomotive hauling a freight train, targeting rail logistics (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32137).

In Sumy region, the Russian "Sever" group conducts infantry battles in Shostka district near Ulanovo and approaches to Volna Sloboda, as well as in Ryzhivka, Pisarevka, Maryino, Khoten village, and south of Ivolzhan (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132).
Six Russian FABs bombed the former Frunze Plant in Sumy (oil/gas equipment production); fighting is currently 13-15 km from Sumy's northern outskirts (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32142).
A high-speed target, likely a missile, was detected in Sumy region heading toward Kyiv region (Source: @kpszsu/71346).

In Kharkiv direction, "Sever" group fights in Ivanovka, Bely Kolodez, Baksheevka, near Shevchenkovo, and forested areas of Volchansk district; a storming group of former prisoners from Ukraine's 72nd Separate Mechanized Brigade attempted infiltration from Izbitskoye to Staritsa but was destroyed (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132).
In Velikoburluk area (Kharkiv region), infantry battles continue west of Petro-Ivanovka, Ustyinovka, and Anishino (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132).

Russian forces control Kupyansk city center and face constant Ukrainian counterattacks from outskirts; fighting for the bridge over Oskol River at Kupyansk-Uzlovoy ongoing (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132).
Ballistic missile threat (Iskander-M/S-300) from Kursk region was announced by monitoring channel (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69632).
Russian forces struck four vessels carrying military cargo for Ukrainian Armed Forces in the port of Mykolaiv and in the Black Sea, per Russian MoD (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32148).
Night strikes continued against Ukrainian port infrastructure: tanks in Odesa region, a cargo ship at sea, and prohibited facilities in Mykolaiv (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132).
A high-speed target in the Black Sea was tracked on course toward Odesa region (Source: @kpszsu/71329).

UAV activity intensive: UAVs over Zaporizhzhia from south, over Mykolaiv region from east heading to Dnipropetrovsk, over Odesa region north of Berezivka heading to Mykolaiv, and over Mykolaiv from west (Source: @kpszsu/71370, @kpszsu/71344, @kpszsu/71332, @kpszsu/71365).
Guided missile circled near Bashtanka in Mykolaiv region (Source: @eRadarrua/103817).
Crimea repelled air attacks overnight along with Tula and Belgorod regions (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132).
Russian MoD confirmed continued strikes on ports, sea vessels, and port infrastructure used by Ukrainian forces (Source: @tass_agency/388517).

Massive Ukrainian UAV attacks overnight on Crimea, Tula, Belgorod, and other regions; Russian air defense claimed 245 UAVs destroyed in previous day, indicating near-nightly large-scale drone operations (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132).
Russian guided aerial bombs (KABs) used on Donetsk and Dnipropetrovsk regions; guided bombs also struck Zaporizhzhia city causing 11 wounded (Source: @kpszsu/71365, @UkraineNow/83125).
Ballistic missile launch threat (Iskander-M/S-300) from Kursk region reported by monitoring channel (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69632).
High-speed targets detected in Black Sea toward Odesa and in Sumy region toward Kyiv, suggesting missile or high-speed drone activity (Source: @kpszsu/71329, @kpszsu/71346).

Widespread UAV sightings across Ukraine: Chernihiv region (Slavutych, Koryukivka, Novgorod-Siversky), Poltava region (Zavodske, Kotelva), Mykolaiv region (Bashtanka), Kharkiv region (from north), Zaporizhzhia (from south), Dnipropetrovsk (north and south), Odesa region (north of Berezivka) (Source: @eRadarrua/103787, @eRadarrua/103830, @eRadarrua/103814, @eRadarrua/103815, @eRadarrua/103817, @kpszsu/71348, @kpszsu/71370, @kpszsu/71381, @kpszsu/71332).
Russian UAV operators from Varyag brigade destroyed a locomotive hauling freight train, demonstrating precision strike capability against rail targets (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32137).
All-clear for ballistic weapon threat issued by monitoring channel after earlier alert (Source: @kpszsu/71349).

key_developments: Russian guided bombs hit gas station in Shyrokivska hromada, Kryvyi Rih district, killing 3 and igniting fire; OVA confirms strike (Source: @UkraineNow/83146).
Ukrainian drones attacked Crimea, Tula, Belgorod overnight; Russia claims 245 UAVs destroyed previous day, indicating sustained mass drone campaign (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132).
Russian forces destroyed Cherevkovsky bridge section in Slavyansk and struck port infrastructure in Odesa, Mykolaiv, and at sea (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132).
Belgorod region drone strike near playground killed 13-year-old girl, injured two other children; rocket fire on Kazachya Lisitsa wounded four (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132).
Russian troops control Kupyansk center, fight for Oskol River bridge at Kupyansk-Uzlovoy; Ukrainian counterattacks from outskirts continue (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32132).
Six Russian FABs bombed Frunze Plant in Sumy; ground fighting 13-15 km from city's northern outskirts (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32142).
Drone crashed on Gelendzhik beach killing 3 (Russian governor) or 6 (Ukrainian source), injuring 13-17; videos show Russian AD engagement (Source: @UkraineNow/83147, @ukr_leaks_eng/32145).
sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces are prioritizing systematic degradation of Ukrainian energy and logistics infrastructure, evidenced by coordinated strikes on gas stations, fuel depots, port facilities, and rail assets across Dnipropetrovsk, Zaporizhzhia, Mykolaiv, and Odesa regions. The use of guided aerial bombs (KABs) in urban areas like Zaporizhzhia and the destruction of the Cherevkovsky bridge in Slavyansk indicate a combined arms approach to interdict supply lines and civilian morale. Meanwhile, Ukrainian long-range drone operations have reached near-nightly saturation, targeting Russian rear areas including oil refineries and population centers, provoking civilian casualties in Belgorod and Gelendzhik that risk domestic political pressure on the Kremlin. The proximity of ground combat to Sumy (13-15 km) and Russian control of Kupyansk suggest continued offensive momentum in the north, while the ballistic missile threat from Kursk adds a strategic dimension. The leadership crisis in the European "Coalition of the Willing" and difficult US-Ukraine talks on Patriot technology transfer may affect sustainment of Ukrainian air defense and long-term security guarantees.
